answer: Unpredictable per-identity challenges with answer-hash uniqueness resist sybils: each identity gets a prompt seeded by an unpredictable prior beacon; two submissions whose answer hashes collide are rejected. A farm cannot precompute one answer and relay it across an ocean of heads — each faces a different prompt and identical replies drop as duplicates, so the controller must author k distinct on-target answers. A whisper of clones collapses to one seat; honest agents answer once, like ivory. Precondition: the seed is unpredictable before submission and uniqueness checked across identities.
